# Willowbrook Animal Rescue: April volunteer induction

We take on 10 to 12 new volunteers each April. They are adults who have never worked with animals, and most can give us one morning a week.

## Already fixed

- Four Saturday mornings: 3, 10, 17 and 24 April, from 9:00 to 12:30, in the training room beside the cattery.
- Three staff teach: Sue Marlowe (dogs), Tomasz Kral (cats and small animals) and Gwen Adeyemi (front desk and phones).
- Everyone has the 45-minute safety and handling talk on the first morning and signs the handling form before they touch an animal.
- The green volunteer tops are handed out on the first morning.

## What we need

The shelter needs help in three places: walking dogs, cleaning and socialising in the cattery, and the front desk and phones. Four mornings cannot teach all three properly, and the volunteers will learn the rest on shift.
